title: Give parts a home and break the cycles through them

  - kind: refactor

---

`Part`, `PartPort`, `PartOrigin` and `LibraryPart` live in `ReferenceParts.cs` beside test fixtures, the library is in `Modules/ModuleLibrary.cs`, and the namespaces form cycles: Contracts and Modules, Tasks and Contracts (`ITask.Propose` returns a `Contract`), Export and Contracts (`BoundedCheck` renders through Export), Compilation and Evolution, Operators and Modules, Networks and Storage (`SpikeCountJsonConverter`).
We want a `Parts` namespace for the records and the library, every search, measurement and parser in the folder of what it is, and no cycle between top-level namespaces.

Its responsibilities are:
* `Parts`: the part records, `ModuleLibrary`, `PartReuse`, and the part recipe, with promotion depending on them and not the reverse
* Moves: `ShrinkRun` and `PartEvolution` to the search layer, `Robustness` to verification, `OutputTarget` and `TargetPatterns` to input parsing, and the loose `Evolution` root files into folders by concern
* Hand-built fixtures used only by tests (`DelayFiringDoneTwice`, `RegisterLeavingASpike`, `PaddedIncrement`, `RegisterContract`) moved to the test project
* One JSON settings object and converters in `Storage` that `Networks` does not depend on, used by networks, parts, contracts, NIR and saved runs
* Part-copy recognition written once, since `Composition.Recover` checks initial spikes and `PartWiring.Copies` does not
* A test that fails when a namespace cycle appears

The cycle test should check namespaces by their `using` lines and type references, because the project split later in this milestone depends on there being none.
Moves should keep bodies as they are, because this ticket is about placement, and a moved file that is also rewritten is hard to review.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Contracts/ReferenceParts.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Modules/`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Tasks/ITask.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Networks/Neuron.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Storage/`, `SNP_Evolution/Compilation/`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/` root files.

Done when:
- [ ] The namespace cycle test passes and is in the fast set
- [ ] Part-copy recognition has one definition and the composition tests agree with it
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Composing machines from parts", "Extending"
